general.abstract:
National Network Name : rbv_czo

Nested watersheds in humid tropical forest of Cameroon
from the Mengong experimental watershed (0.6 km2) to the Nyong River at Olama (18500 km2)
Granitoid bedrock
secondary forest
low anthropogenic pressure
Monitoring initiated in 1994 for some parameters
more details at : https://mtropics.obs-mip.fr/

images.alt: Suspended particulate matter from the Mengong stream
walking track in the Nsimi watershed

environmentalCharacteristics.geology: Plutonic rocks, essentially granitoids : (a) liberian charnockites (near 2900 Myr), (b) more potassic and leucocratic granites (2700-2600 Myr)
environmentalCharacteristics.hydrology: runoff = 400mm +/- 130, can be interrupted during driest months Ke(%) = 20-25%
environmentalCharacteristics.soils: deep lateritic profiles on hill sides, colluvions topped by greyish clearly hydromorphic horizon in swamp depressions
environmentalCharacteristics.vegetation: The Yaoundé-Sangmélima-Abong Mbang triangle belongs to the domain of the semi-deciduous congo-guinean forest, characterized by Stertuliaceae and Ulmaceae. In the Nsimi catchment, hills and sidehills are covered by secondary forest; the virgin forest is no more found in the region actually, except in rare scraps; a lot of areas have been deforested for growing traditional food crops like manioc, macabo, banana, peanut, corn? the swampy depressions are often colonized by Raphia cf montbuttorum.
